WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc AS q
  JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), funding_counts AS (
  SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS project_count
  FROM project_counts
  GROUP BY fundflux
)
SELECT fundflux,
       project_count,
       1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total,
       1.0 * project_count / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS divided_by_average
FROM funding_counts;
